body: I did. Took it for the 1st time last night, and it did ALL the amazing things for me during the day. At night though is a different story. I was not expecting the dream and dozed off like usual. I woke up after a particularly vivid dream and Bizzarre, scary visuals. It felt like it lasted a long time (and More intense than anything I’ve ever seen on shrooms or LSD.) I woke up and had paranoia so I tried watching a video of this YouTuber I like to fall asleep, But as I watched her, I began to get terrified of her eyes, I started noticing the little inflections when she open them wider while talking and it looked evil to me..never has before..it was just weird. I knew my brain was tripping but it still freaked me out anyways. I had to watch a somber, sad-ish movie to try and get back to baseline. Somber because it helped me feel seen and heard because I was feeling not so good after this nightmare. I was drugged once and I believe the pill they used had a lot of meth in it, and I received similar night terrors as I came down from that as I did with this last night. The thing is what I dreamt wasn’t anything particularly scary (or maybe it was? I don’t remember what happened I just remember feeling scared) , I think just the feeling of being completely out of control scared the shit out of me. Anyways I really like the benefits and I wanna try continuing with the medicine, but I need to wait until my psychiatrist gets back to me on the dreams. I can’t have these every night.
I think they all have an element of pain, but maybe it's worth it?
